pom.xml: Maven build descriptor targeting Java 11. Declares dependency org.junit.jupiter:junit-jupiter (scope test) and configures a JUnit 5-capable Maven Surefire plugin so mvn -q test executes JUnit Jupiter tests.

src/main/java/Position.java: public final class Position { public Position(int x,int y); public int getX(); public int getY(); public Position translate(int dx,int dy); public boolean equals(Object o); public int hashCode(); }. Semantics: immutable value object; translate returns a new Position(x+dx,y+dy). equals/hashCode use x and y only.

src/main/java/Orientation.java: public enum Orientation { NORTH, EAST, SOUTH, WEST; public int dx(); public int dy(); public Orientation left(); public Orientation right(); }. Semantics: NORTH(0,-1), EAST(1,0), SOUTH(0,1), WEST(-1,0). left/right rotate 90 degrees.

src/main/java/Command.java: public enum Command { MOVE_FORWARD, TURN_LEFT, TURN_RIGHT, FIRE }. No extras.

src/main/java/Tank.java: public class Tank { private final String id; private Position position; private Orientation orientation; private int health; public Tank(String id, Position position, Orientation orientation, int health); public String getId(); public Position getPosition(); public Orientation getOrientation(); public int getHealth(); public boolean isAlive(); /* package-private */ void setPosition(Position position); /* package-private */ void rotateLeft(); /* package-private */ void rotateRight(); /* package-private */ void applyDamage(int amount); public Tank copy(); }. Semantics: constructor validates id nonblank, position/orientation non-null; health>=0 (health==0 allowed) else IllegalArgumentException. isAlive() iff health>0. rotateLeft/right mutate orientation using Orientation.left/right. applyDamage(int amount) reduces health by positive amount not below zero. copy() returns a deep logical copy, supporting dead tanks.

src/main/java/Projectile.java: public class Projectile { private final String shooterId; private Position position; private final Orientation orientation; public Projectile(String shooterId, Position position, Orientation orientation); public String getShooterId(); public Position getPosition(); public Orientation getOrientation(); /* package-private */ void setPosition(Position position); public Projectile copy(); }. Semantics: mutable position set only via setPosition; other fields immutable after construction. copy() returns a new Projectile with same values.

src/main/java/ObstacleMap.java: public class ObstacleMap { public static ObstacleMap empty(); public void add(Position p); public boolean isBlocked(Position p); public ObstacleMap copy(); }. Semantics: backed by a Set<Position>; add inserts a blocking cell; isBlocked tests membership; copy returns deep copy.

src/main/java/Arena.java: public class Arena { private final int width; private final int height; private final ObstacleMap obstacles; public Arena(int width, int height, ObstacleMap obstacles); public boolean inBounds(Position p); public boolean isObstacle(Position p); public Arena copy(); }. Semantics: validates width>0,height>0; defensively copies obstacles in constructor and copy(). inBounds checks 0<=x<width and 0<=y<height.

src/main/java/ScoreBoard.java: public class ScoreBoard { private final java.util.Map<String,Integer> hits; private final java.util.Map<String,Integer> kills; public ScoreBoard(java.util.Collection<String> ids); public void addHit(String id); public void addKill(String id); public int getHits(String id); public int getKills(String id); public int getScore(String id); public java.util.Map<String,Integer> asMap(); public ScoreBoard copy(); public void reset(java.util.Collection<String> tankIds); }. Semantics: initialize hits/kills=0 for each provided id; add* increments; getScore = hits + 5*kills; asMap returns a snapshot map of total scores per id or a structured map per requirement (implement consistently with tests); copy returns deep copy; reset reinitializes hits/kills to zero for the provided ids (clears unknown ids), and is invoked from GameEngine.reset via scoreBoard.reset(initialTanks.keySet()).

src/main/java/GameEngine.java: public class GameEngine { private Arena arena; private final Arena initialArena; private java.util.Map<String,Tank> tanks; private final java.util.Map<String,Tank> initialTanks; private final ScoreBoard scoreBoard; public GameEngine(Arena arena, java.util.List<Tank> tanks); public void enqueue(String tankId, Command cmd); public void tick(); public void reset(); public java.util.Map<String,Tank> getTanksCopy(); public java.util.List<Projectile> getProjectilesCopy(); public ScoreBoard getScoreBoardCopy(); public Arena getArena(); public String winner(); }. Constructor semantics: validate at least two initially alive tanks (health>0), unique ids, distinct positions, all in-bounds and not obstacles. Deep-copy arena (store copy in both initialArena and current arena as required). Initialize one empty FIFO command queue per tank. For every supplied tank perform literally: Tank initialCopy = tank.copy(); Tank currentCopy = tank.copy(); this.initialTanks.put(tank.getId(), initialCopy); this.tanks.put(tank.getId(), currentCopy);. ScoreBoard constructed with initial alive tank ids. No Java Stream API anywhere. enqueue adds Command to the FIFO for the given tank id if it exists. tick: process at most one command for each live tank in lexicographic id order. MOVE_FORWARD: attempt to move one cell forward unless out-of-bounds, obstacle, or occupied by a live tank; dead tanks do not block. TURN_LEFT/RIGHT rotate orientation. FIRE: spawn a projectile in the forward cell only if in bounds and not an obstacle. After commands, advance all projectiles one cell using Projectile.setPosition; remove any projectile out-of-bounds or into an obstacle; on first non-owner live tank occupying the new cell, applyDamage(1), scoreBoard.addHit(shooterId), and if tank health reaches 0 also scoreBoard.addKill(shooterId); consume projectile upon hit. reset: assign this.arena = initialArena.copy(); assign this.tanks = new java.util.HashMap<String,Tank>(); iterate initialTanks.values() (no streams) to copy each into current tanks; recreate empty command queues; clear all projectiles; and call scoreBoard.reset(initialTanks.keySet()). getTanksCopy/getProjectilesCopy/getScoreBoardCopy return fresh defensive copies. winner: return sole surviving tank id only when exactly one of the at-least-two initial tanks is alive; otherwise return null. All runtime state mutations occur on the current tanks map; initialTanks is never mutated after construction.

src/main/java/Main.java: public final class Main { public static void main(String[] args); }. Semantics: thin headless demo. Build a small arena and two tanks, create engine, optionally enqueue a couple of commands, tick once, then print one concise snapshot of tank ids and scores; use fully qualified java.util.Arrays.asList(...); do not loop or call System.exit.

Import/usage rules: All classes are in the default package; no package declarations. Tests only use public APIs described above and must fetch fresh copies from GameEngine after each tick/reset. GameEngine never uses java.util.stream.*.
